title: Country 02
name: country-02
arc:
A longer line-dance phrase. It opens weighted on the character-right foot with the character-left foot lifted in a step-touch, arms low at the waist. From frame 8 the character-left arm swings out and up, reaching overhead by frame 10, and the weight crosses to the character-left foot at frame 11 while that arm stays up.

The back half resolves the arm down and trades the feet again. Pingpong: frames 0 and 35 are the turnarounds, both grounded. The arm raise is the accent of the phrase; draw it full height.
